text:
Ravi Desai: quick sync  we need to finalize penalty normalization rules for policy-eval so runtime gets a clear signal.

Jules Park: proposed output from control-plane: { penalty_score, band, policy_version }. runtime only consumes band and policy_version.

Marta Ruiz: normalization idea: convert each raw penalty into [0..1] using its scale_hint, then combine with product(1 - x) to get final score. product-combine reduces double-counting.

Ethan Cole: agree with product approach. runtime should not act on tiny float deltas; map score->discrete bands (0..3). bands drive deterministic actions (no action, degrade, prefer-dedicated, reject).

Jules Park: also add policy blob fields: ttl_seconds, band_mapping_override (per-tenant), emergency_override_flag. version every blob.

policy-bot: note: staging run scheduled for policy-eval v2 with penalty_score traces. ticket INF-3902.

Marta Ruiz: logging: include policy_version, penalty_score, band, and override_reason in traces. helps root cause.

Ravi Desai: ops note: runtime cache TTL should respect blob.ttl_seconds but have a max cap (5m). stale policy -> safe-mode band 1 and alert.

Ethan Cole: action items: Jules to draft short RFC with pseudocode + worked example, Marta to add trace schema, Ravi to validate TTL cap with SRE.

Jules Park: will post RFC later today. tagging reviewers. :rocket:
